title: The output Torque of the sphere contacts is the negative of the friction torque on marker 0
author: Claude-JG
description: ObjectContactSphereSphere, SphereTriangle, SphereTorus and SphereCylinder give as output variable Torque the negative of the friction torque on marker 0, which their descriptions name, while their output Force is the force on marker 0 with the right sign: a ball sliding in +x on the ground gets the friction force -x, which Force shows, and starts to turn about +y, but Torque shows -y. The simulation is right; only the output is affected. The description of SphereCylinder also names the forces on the two markers with the wrong signs. Decided: Torque is the torque on marker 0 about its position, (p_c - p_0) x f with the contact point p_c and the force f on marker 0, for the four items; the description of SphereCylinder corrected.
releaseNotes: The output variable Torque of ObjectContactSphereSphere, ObjectContactSphereTriangle, ObjectContactSphereTorus and ObjectContactSphereCylinder is the friction torque on marker 0; it had the opposite sign. The simulation was not affected.
